goal: src/lib/refusals/vocabulary.ts owns a code to Refusal category map for all five remaining lanes, so slices #1010, #1011 and #1012 can each write their lane without editing a file another slice is editing.
non_goals: Every Refusal write site. This slice adds no call to writeRefusalEvent and changes no runtime behaviour.
The policy_gate_held lane's 22-member AutoApprovalBlockReason map, its precedence order and its veto set. #1013 carries that vocabulary, and #1003 locked rulings this slice must not pre-empt.
The held_draft lane's fixed category. #1013 carries it, and #1001 declined to pin it in the schema.
refusalCategoryFor, REFUSAL_CATEGORY_META and any owner-facing label. The Restraint tab (#1014) owns presentation.
The set-based arm of writeRefusalEvent. #1010 adds it, because #1010 is the lane that needs it.
Any migration. Migration 116 is applied to staging and production and this slice adds no SQL.

RENDER_WITHHOLD_REASONS from the parked branch. #1002 killed read.ts and that constant existed only for read.ts's timestamp partition; RenderWithholdReason in src/lib/solicitation/outreach.ts is the live owner.
user_visible_behavior: No owner-visible change and no runtime change. The maps are constants with no production caller until #1010, #1011 and #1012 land.

A developer adding a member to WithholdReason, OutreachWithheldReason, RenderWithholdReason, LatchHaltReason or AutoPolicyDowngradeReason without deciding its Refusal category gets a compile error rather than an unmapped lane at run time.
invariants: Every map is satisfies Record<SourceEnum, RefusalCategory | null>, so a new member of the source enum is a compile error until it is mapped.
null in a map means the code is not a Refusal. It is never a missing entry and never a default.
Every import in vocabulary.ts stays import type. The Restraint tab is a client surface and one value import whose graph reaches a node: builtin would enter the browser bundle.

src/lib/refusals/vocabulary.ts imports nothing from worker/. AutoPolicyDowngradeReason moves to src/lib/shared/worker-types.ts, which is where AutonomySuspensionTrigger already lives for the same reason.
The dispatch lane and the render lane keep SEPARATE maps. Both write refusal_source outreach_withheld, but they carry different closed enums and #997 counted them as different writers.
Category values are members of REFUSAL_CATEGORIES. A category string that migration 116's CHECK rejects must not be spellable.
The mapped categories are harvested verbatim from feat/refusal-log's vocabulary.ts. This slice re-decides no category.
edge_cases: velocity_banked is null: a banked candidate is deferred, not refused, so the ask lane writes no Refusal for it.
owner_veto, owner_halt, send_window_elapsed and batch_expired are null: an owner halting their own batch is not RepWorth refusing, and an elapsed window is not a decision we made.
admin_halt and platform_halt are both autonomy_paused: platform_halt writes no account_audit_log row, and that asymmetry is invisible to the category map.
AutoPolicyDowngradeReason keeps six members: judge_disabled and judge_unhealthy map to the same category but stay two codes, because refusal_code is stored verbatim.
LatchHaltReason was private. Exporting a type adds no runtime surface and no bundle weight.
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/lib/refusals/vocabulary.ts AUTONOMY_SUSPENDED_REFUSAL_CATEGORIES — the map shape this slice repeats five times: as const satisfies Record<Enum, RefusalCategory>, one comment per null entry.
The parked feat/refusal-log branch's src/lib/refusals/vocabulary.ts — the harvest source for every category value.
src/lib/shared/worker-types.ts AutonomySuspensionTrigger — the precedent for a worker-domain union parked in src/lib/shared so src/lib may read it.
src/lib/refusals/__tests__/vocabulary.test.ts — the existing exhaustiveness and migration-parse test file this slice extends.
test_seams: src/lib/refusals/vocabulary.ts — the five exported maps and their key unions.
worker/jobs/publisher/auto-policy-downgrade.ts — the re-exported type its existing DOWNGRADE_MARKERS record already pins.
tests_to_add: ASK_WITHHELD_REFUSAL_CATEGORIES maps every WithholdReason and marks velocity_banked as not a Refusal
OUTREACH_WITHHELD_DISPATCH_REFUSAL_CATEGORIES maps every OutreachWithheldReason to a category
OUTREACH_WITHHELD_RENDER_REFUSAL_CATEGORIES maps every RenderWithholdReason to a category
BATCH_HALTED_REFUSAL_CATEGORIES maps only admin_halt and platform_halt to a category and the other four to null
AUTO_POST_REVOKED_REFUSAL_CATEGORIES maps every AutoPolicyDowngradeReason to a category
every category any lane map assigns is a member of REFUSAL_CATEGORIES
the dispatch and render outreach maps stay separate and agree on the codes they share
vocabulary.ts imports no value at runtime, so the Restraint tab may import it
rollback_plan: Revert the PR on main. The maps have no production caller in this slice, so a revert removes constants and two type exposures and changes no behaviour. Nothing is written to any database and no migration is involved. If a swarm branch has already merged on top, revert that branch first — its write site is the only thing that reads a map.
